SELECT p.PRODUCT_ID as productId, p.PRODUCT_NAME as productName, p.PRODUCT_TYPE as productType, p.PRICE as price, p.DEPOSIT as deposit, p.DESCRIPTION as description, p.IS_AVAILABLE as isAvailable, p.CREATED_AT as createdAt, p.CATEGORY_ID as categoryId, p.BRAND_ID as brandId, b.BRAND_NAME as brandName, i.IMG_URL as imgUrl FROM PRODUCT p
LEFT JOIN BRAND b ON p.BRAND_ID = b.BRAND_ID
LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG i ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID AND i.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE 1=1
AND p.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'RENTAL'
AND p.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'PURCHASE'
AND 1 = 0
AND p.BRAND_ID IN
#{id}
